reasoning_content: All three have started. Memory is currently 5.6GB free (containers only). Three Angular builds simultaneously: in the previous first "just up" run, app and cms each took about 3.5 minutes under high load, and boards failed once due to memory. This time it's a cold Vite build, so it could take 3-8 minutes. I'll wait while checking memory. If memory tightens up again, the builds will slow down, but since containers are using less memory, they shouldn't crash.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 9); do
  ok=0
  for p in 38489 45423 43781; do
    code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$code" = "200" ] && ok=$((ok+1))
  done
  echo "check $i: $ok/3 up  $(free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "free="$6"MB"}')"
  [ $ok -eq 3 ] && break
  sleep 55
done
